result.question: What does the old prophet do with the body?

readings.answer: He lays it in his own tomb.
readings.support: Then he laid the body in his own tomb,

readings.answer: He brings it back to his own city.
readings.support: brought it back to his own city

readings.answer: He lifts it up and puts it on a donkey.
readings.support: lifted up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey

assessments.reason: “Then he laid the body in his own tomb” matches “buried him in his grave,” with tomb/grave as equivalents.
“Brought it back to his own city” is explicitly stated and is something he does with the body, though it is an earlier step than the burial emphasized by the key.
He “lifted up the body … [and] laid it on the donkey” is a clear action with the body, even if not the final burial the key highlights.
